visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up display of the finished dish, Stir-fried Beef Macaroni, in a black bowl set on a wooden table. The dish features large tubular pasta mixed with thinly sliced beef, bean sprouts, and green onion garnishes. (2) In a glass bowl, raw beef slices are prepared. A person wearing a white chef's coat and plastic gloves pours soy sauce, sugar, oyster sauce, white pepper, and wine over the meat. (3) Hands mix the meat and seasonings thoroughly, then add cornstarch and oil to finish the marinade process. (4) In a black skillet, oil is heated, and the marinated beef is added. A blue spatula is used to stir-fry the beef until it is partially cooked, then it is transferred back to a glass bowl. (5) Sliced onions and green bell peppers are added to the hot skillet and tossed quickly. (6) Pre-cooked rigatoni-style macaroni is added from a bowl into the skillet with the vegetables. (7) Sugar, soy sauce, and oyster sauce are poured over the macaroni and tossed to coat evenly. (8) Fresh bean sprouts, yellow chives, and the partially cooked beef are added back into the pan. The chef vigorously tosses the pan to combine all ingredients. (9) The final shot shows the completed dish in the bowl, steaming and glistening.
